items.title: Emmanuel Sayles Interview, 1961-01-29
items.q: we had Homer Eugene, we had Randy Hall

ctx.x: John was the best, yeah. And I had another fellow player with Sidney Desby named Percy Sevier. Well, he wasn't playing so much when he came, but after he had been around, he got to be a very good banjo player too. Then we were like, around in the mid-30s, we had Homer Eugene, we had Randy Hall, and had another fellow named Paul, I can't hear his name, Paul Sufferman, and Sidney Fludger, well, he did a lot of singing, and he also played nice banjo too. I could say, Lawrence Moray was around, but John Moray was in…
you know, yeah. So you were working with that trio for quite a while, I guess.
